keySentence: Sara's imagination sustained her through her darkest days and kept her spirit alive.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: There were days in the attic when Sara felt closer to despair than ever before. The cold reached into her bones and the hunger made it hard to think clearly. Miss Minchin had been cruel and not one person in the school had been kind to her. On those darkest nights Sara used the one tool that had never once failed her. She lay very still and began to build a world inside her mind with great care. She gave names to the attic rats and invented stories for every one of them. She made the bare walls glow with imaginary warmth until sleep finally came. Her spirit did not break because she never stopped feeding it with beautiful stories. Sara's imagination sustained her through her darkest days and kept her spirit alive.
